name: FilmCraft
purpose: Agent-usable FilmCraft (ArtCraft/storytold, MIT or Apache-2.0; a Premiere-style editor in Rust) through its headless CLI: commands, the sequence as a CL Scene, scripted edits, export and frames.
permissions: Runs the locally built filmcraft-cli headless (no window, no bridge to a desktop app)
Reads the media you name and writes the .fcproj and exports you name

actions.name: neyvia.mod.filmcraft.commands
actions.description: List FilmCraft engine commands (id, label, params) matching a filter.

actions.name: neyvia.mod.filmcraft.inspect
actions.description: Observe a project's active sequence as a CL Scene: tracks, clips, in/out, effects, transitions, markers.

actions.name: neyvia.mod.filmcraft.run
actions.description: Run engine commands in order on a project (a new project when omitted) and save it.

actions.name: neyvia.mod.filmcraft.export
actions.description: Export the active sequence and check the outcome contracts on the file.

actions.name: neyvia.mod.filmcraft.frame
actions.description: Render one Program frame to PNG.

actions.name: neyvia.mod.filmcraft.verify
actions.description: Real round trip: import real Neyvia captures, place clips, export, then the outcome contracts.

credit: storytold/filmcraft (ArtCraft team), dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; used here under Apache-2.0. Mod written by the two Neyvia video tracks (track/video and track/laya-video), reconciled on 7 Oct.
